scenarios.expected: Clean packaged installation starts without a development server and opens an encrypted synthetic database.
Packaged upgrade preserves synthetic records, migration integrity, audit history, and the approved retained-data policy.
Uninstall and reinstall behavior follows the approved retention policy without losing protected encrypted data or native-module compatibility.
The packaged Hub reopens the encrypted database with the approved OS-backed key and fails closed for an invalid or missing key.
IPC, navigation, logging, local-storage, and privilege boundaries fail closed without exposing sensitive data.
The Windows Hub LAN endpoint, firewall rule, TLS certificate, and enrolled-device connectivity operate only through the approved trust boundary.
Admin-controlled encrypted removable-media backup produces an integrity manifest without plaintext database, vault, or key artifacts.
A replacement Hub restores the encrypted backup with matching schema, counts, hashes, vault contents, and Admin approval.
An interrupted upgrade rolls back without losing patient sequence, audit trail, document metadata, catalog version, or encrypted data.
The approved APK installs on floor and current devices and completes Admin-approved enrollment with correct device binding and scopes.
The app starts and operates according to offline policy without internet or LAN, and inactivity lock behaves as configured.
The configured thirty-day offline-access boundary expires correctly and follows the documented recovery or re-enrollment path.
Unavailable or invalid Android Keystore identity material fails closed without silently creating a replacement identity or exposing data.
SQLCipher Room opens and migrations 1 through 6 preserve synthetic data without destructive fallback, including after process death.
All six approved synchronization scopes negotiate, verify, and apply minimum-necessary payloads; unauthorized scopes are rejected.
Two Android devices demonstrate durable device-scoped claims, fairness, conflict recovery, and stale-claim recovery without duplicate application.
Wrong trust anchors and permanent security failures fail closed; transient outage recovers through retry-now and safe sync health.
Process death during synchronization recovers without losing queued work, duplicating claims, or weakening session security.
Android receives and validates only the minimized EGP billing summary, rejects malformed payloads, and cannot perform unauthorized billing writes.
Authorized Android view/upload works through the Hub vault, unauthorized roles are denied, and Android persistence inventory is clean.
FLAG_SECURE and viewer cleanup are observed for screenshots, recents, recording, rotation, cancellation, and process death.
Picker MIME, size, cancellation, unreadable-provider, and camera-optional behavior pass on the supported device classes.
Signed APK checksum/signature, installation, upgrade, rollback, device revocation, and re-enrollment pass.

approval.decisionNotes: Do not approve clinical production while any required scenario is pending, blocked, or failed.
